name: Linear Project Management MCP
shortDescription: Create, assign, update, and search issues, projects, cycles, and roadmaps in Linear workspace.
longDescription: Streamline sprint tracking and issue creation directly from developer discussions. Search issues, update statuses, attach links, and create new engineering tasks in Linear.
author: jerhadf

tools.name: linear_create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue with title, description, team, and assignee.

tools.name: linear_search_issues
tools.description: Search Linear issues by query or filter by status.

tools.name: linear_update_issue
tools.description: Update state, priority, or details of an existing issue.

installSteps.title: Configure Linear API Key
installSteps.description: Generate key at linear.app/settings/api and add to client config.
